zh.sectionNoteBody: 这里是 DSH 宿主的真实「模型」页，只用于说明设置窗口的菜单列与内容列。插件增加一页时注册 settings.section，让宿主承载该页；不要再套一层完整设置窗口。

en.sectionNoteTitle: Which layer a plugin page belongs to
en.sectionNoteBody: This is the DSH host's real Models page, shown only to explain the settings window's menu column and content column. When a plugin adds a page, it registers settings.section and lets the host carry that page; do not wrap it in another full settings window.
